payload.text: Peptide & Oligo Manufacturer & CDMO | Bachem Skip to content Leading partner in TIDES Peptide & Oligonucleotide CDMO Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company that develops and manufactures peptides and oligonucleotides as Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), from early clinical development through to commercial GMP supply, for pharma and biotech worldwide. Contact us Knowledge Hub 50+ Years of experience 150+ Ongoing CMC projects 2,500+ Team members globally Our peptide and oligonucleotide CDMO services End-to-end CDMO support for peptide and oligonucleotide therapeutics. From research synthesis to commercial manufacturing, with integrated analytical, regulatory, and catalog services at every phase. Clinical development for Peptides Comprehensive support for the clinical development of your Peptide API. Commercial manufacturing of Peptides GMP manufacturing of Peptide APIs. Custom Peptide synthesis Custom peptides synthesized for your research needs. Catalog products Your research made easy with thousands of catalog products. Clinical development for Oligonucleotides Comprehensive support for the clinical development of your Oligonucleotide API. Commercial manufacturing of Oligonucleotides GMP manufacturing of Oligonucleotide APIs. Why partner with Bachem? End-to-end vertical integration. From amino acid derivatives and building blocks through to large-scale commercial API, supported by deep analytical, quality and regulatory expertise. Global manufacturing you can rely on. Four GMP-certified sites across Switzerland and the United States , delivering reliable global supply at scales from milligrams to multi-tonne commercial volumes. Science-led. Sustainability-committed. Innovative by nature, responsible by design, and focused on getting your therapeutics to patients safely and at scale. Become part of the Bachem world Our success is driven by our people. We offer an international, science-driven environment where expertise, collaboration and continuous development matter. From apprentices to experienced professionals, we create opportunities to grow, take ownership and make a real impact in a dynamic and expanding industry.
